transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good morning, thank you for calling S-Net Customer Support. My name is Harriet. How can I help you with your account today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Harriet, my name is Orlaith. I am ringing because I switched to S-Net Fibre 300 two months ago for the seventy-five pound prepaid MasterCard reward, and it still hasn't arrived.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am really sorry to hear that your seventy-five pound prepaid reward card still hasn't come through after two months, as I completely understand how frustrating it is waiting on a sign-up incentive you were promised.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Honestly it is really annoying. That seventy-five pound reward card was the main reason I chose the Fibre 300 deal over another provider.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So just to make sure I have the full picture, you activated your S-Net Fibre 300 package around sixty days ago under the promotional seventy-five pound prepaid MasterCard offer, and you have not received the card or claim link yet, is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that is spot on. Sixty-two days since the engineer installed the box on the wall, to be exact.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will check what has happened with that promotion right away. Before I open your billing profile, could you please confirm your full postal address and your four-digit security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sure, my address is 19 Meadowbank Crescent, Sheffield, S8 7RL, and my four-digit PIN is 4829.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for verifying those security details. I have your S-Net Fibre 300 account open on my screen now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Great. Can you see why the reward card hasn't been sent out to me yet?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me ask a few questions so I can trace the promotional tracking properly. Did you place your Fibre 300 order directly on the S-Net website, or did you click through from a broadband comparison site?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I clicked through from Uswitch on the fifth of August because they had the exclusive seventy-five pound prepaid MasterCard banner on the Fibre 300 listing.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Got it, thank you. When you redirected from Uswitch to the S-Net checkout page, did you receive an automated affiliate registration email with a voucher tracking reference number?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I did! I actually kept the email right here. The Uswitch reward reference is USW-994182-SN, and it said the claim link would arrive within forty-five days of service activation.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That reference number is very helpful. And could you confirm the exact date the Openreach engineer completed the Fibre 300 installation at your property?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The engineer finished installing the optical network terminal on the fourteenth of August, and my broadband went live that same afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Have you checked your email spam, junk, and promotions folders over the past three weeks for any messages from S-Net Rewards or Blackhawk Network?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I have searched my inbox and spam folder every single day for 'S-Net', 'Blackhawk', and 'MasterCard', and nothing at all has landed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Did you happen to have an ad-blocker or strict privacy extension enabled in your browser when you clicked from Uswitch to S-Net on the fifth of August, or did you amend the order by phone afterwards?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, I completed the whole order online in one go without touching anything by phone, and Uswitch even sent me their confirmation saying my order was tracked.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me inspect the affiliate referral ledger linked to your order ID SN-7730419. Give me just a second while I open the promotional log.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can see the affiliate tag USW-994182-SN was captured when you ordered on the fifth of August, and your Fibre 300 service passed the thirty-day minimum cooling-off period on the thirteenth of September.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right, so if it was captured and passed the cooling-off window over a month ago, why haven't I been sent the seventy-five pounds?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: According to the affiliate portal status note here, the batch file export to our external prepaid card partner failed with an 'Unmatched Email Handshake' error on the twentieth of September.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: An unmatched email handshake? My email hasn't changed in ten years! Can you just push it through or send me the card now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Look, the third-party voucher fulfilment agency Blackhawk runs that reward card promotion, that's not our department and you'd normally have to email their claims desk yourself.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Excuse me? I didn't sign a contract with Blackhawk, I signed a twenty-four month broadband contract with S-Net! Why are you telling me it's not your department?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Because S-Net only supplies the broadband line and passes the order file over. Once the referral batch is generated, Blackhawk Network manages the virtual and physical MasterCard dispatch.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You just told me the batch file export from S-Net failed with an handshake error! If S-Net's export failed, Blackhawk won't even have my claim, so emailing them myself will get me nowhere.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: They have a manual exception form where customers upload their Uswitch confirmation PDF and their first S-Net bill so Blackhawk can verify the order.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is ridiculous. I have already waited sixty-two days and now you want me to chase a third-party agency with PDFs because your system failed to export my email?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is the standard process set out in the promotional terms and conditions when an affiliate voucher batch doesn't sync automatically.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, I am not accepting being fobbed off to an external claims desk. Can you not reissue the voucher or sort this out from your side at S-Net?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I really don't know why customers expect technical and billing support to chase affiliate gift cards.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wow, did you seriously just say that to me? That is incredibly rude! I am calling S-Net Customer Support about an S-Net sign-up promotion that S-Net failed to process!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I didn't mean for that to sound rude, I am just explaining that the gift card portal is managed outside our regular billing system.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Well it sounded very dismissive. Look, seventy-five pounds is two and a half months of my Fibre 300 bill. If you can't send the MasterCard, just credit seventy-five pounds onto my S-Net broadband bill instead!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wait—actually, applying an equivalent promotional bill credit directly onto your S-Net broadband account is something I can do if we cancel the unclaimed Blackhawk voucher code first.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Really? Honestly, I would much rather have seventy-five pounds knocked straight off my broadband bill than faff around with a prepaid card anyway!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If we do that, I will need to void voucher reference USW-994182-SN in the affiliate portal so it cannot be claimed twice, and then apply a tax-free seventy-five pound promotional adjustment directly to your S-Net ledger.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, please do that right now! That solves the whole headache for me.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly process that for you now. Because seventy-five pounds is above the standard fifty-pound front-line credit threshold, I just need to run the promotional buyout code through our billing override tool.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No problem at all, how long will that take?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It will only take about a minute. May I place you on a brief hold while I void the external Blackhawk claim ID and post the seventy-five pound credit onto your S-Net account?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, of course, take your time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding. I have voided the stuck Blackhawk voucher reference USW-994182-SN so you won't have to contact any third party, and I have applied the full seventy-five pound credit directly to your S-Net account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, brilliant! So that seventy-five pounds is sitting on my broadband account right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, it is live on your ledger under adjustment reference ADJ-884920. Previously your account balance was zero because your October direct debit had already cleared.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And what does my balance show on your screen now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your S-Net account balance now shows minus seventy-five pounds and zero pence in credit.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How will that work with my upcoming monthly bills? My Fibre 300 package is twenty-nine pounds and ninety-nine pence a month.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your next bill on the fourteenth of November for twenty-nine pounds and ninety-nine pence will be paid automatically from the credit, leaving forty-five pounds and one penny in credit.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, and then December's bill will come out of the rest of the credit too?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly. Your December bill of twenty-nine pounds and ninety-nine pence will also be covered in full, leaving fifteen pounds and two pence to come off your January bill, so your bank direct debit won't take a penny in November or December.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me just refresh my My S-Net billing page on my phone while I have you on the line so I can see it for myself.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please go ahead and refresh the billing tab—it updates in real time as soon as an adjustment ID is committed.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hang on, it is just loading the payments and credits summary now...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Take all the time you need to check it.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes! Right at the top under Current Balance it says minus seventy-five pounds, Credit Balance, and under recent transactions it says Promotional Reward Buyout Credit seventy-five pounds!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is great news, I am glad it is showing clearly on your My S-Net app straight away.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And just to be one hundred percent sure, Blackhawk won't suddenly contact me or try to charge anything back since you cancelled the voucher code?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No, the affiliate claim USW-994182-SN is permanently marked as 'Redeemed via Direct Bill Credit' on the reconciliation table, so the matter is completely closed.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Could you also send me an email confirmation of the seventy-five pound credit and the adjustment reference number just for my records?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have just triggered an automated credit note receipt for adjustment ADJ-884920 to your registered email address, which will arrive within the next two minutes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: In fact, my phone just buzzed—the S-Net credit confirmation email has already landed in my inbox.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Even better. Everything on your Fibre 300 speed and connection has been running smoothly since the August installation otherwise?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the broadband itself has been rock solid at three hundred megabits, it was literally just the missing reward card that had me annoyed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am glad the connection itself has been working well for you, and that your seventy-five pound credit is now safely on your bill.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, having it come straight off my November, December, and January bills is actually much more convenient than a prepaid card.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else at all I can help you with on your S-Net account today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that is everything sorted now. Thanks for applying the credit in the end.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are very welcome. Have a lovely rest of your week, goodbye!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Take care, bye now.
